what_happened: Scene: layout/style 6 (wood cabinets, granite counter, toaster oven); knife (knife_5) in a drawer 2.6 m from the board; the thin flat steak_8 (the same model s20 and s21 failed to lift) on a light-blue plate 1.9 m from the board. Stage 0: a first close starting at 252 brushed the knife (touch 269-275, no lift; listed as on_nothing) and reopened; second close at 310 grasped it (lift 0.46 m from 324), long base move, released on the board at 603 (0.038 m from centre). Stage 1 (437 steps, mostly navigation to the plate and back): the gripper came down over the steak's bone end and closed only to 0.060 m at ~824-832, i.e. the fingers closed around the whole width of the narrow end of the steak instead of pinching its thin edge; it lifted it 0.35 m, carried it back and released it on the board at 1019 (0.035 m from centre). Success at 1042.
self_recovery: One non-lifting close on the knife at 252 before the grasp at 310; otherwise none needed.
official_criterion_notes: The steak grasp is missing from gripper.close_events: the fingers only went from 0.080 to 0.060 (closing around a 6 cm wide object), which the close-event detector does not count, although the meat hold 836-1019 is recorded. Also the 252 close is listed as on_nothing although the knife was touched at 269-275 during it.
